reviews.text: I love your place and employees! Emi gets so excited as we get close to your Hotel on Highland... She can't wait to get out of the car and start playing! So Happy To Have Found It !  Thank You!!
Great staff and convient hours, don't know of any other that allows 24 hr pick-up/drop off. The only down side for us is it's far from home.

Very happy with my experience so far. My puppy was rescued from the street and is very shy but the team at Wag truly help him come out of his shell and get more comfortable with humans other than myself. He is also making a ton of friends which is super cool to watch on their webcam. 10/10 would recommend
Wag took great care of my kitty when I had to board her last minute. They were very responsive and understanding!

We love Wag Hotels Hollywood! The staff is really attentive and genuinely loves the dogs they care for. I have two high energy Malinois (IYKYK) and it gives us so much peace of mind knowing our pups are in good hands while we’re away. Highly recommend!

its my dog first ever boarding experience and it was great! they updated us on her first day and send daily photos. My dog is not sociable but she was able to be around other dogs without any problems.

I’ve taken my dog here for over a year and I love this location. The staff is amazing and clearly care about all the dogs. They even give me updates on how much my dog ate or played. I love taking my pup here and he loves going!
These guys are great. They call me and send me photos of my dog with updates while I am away and take great care of him.
Thank you for taking great care of my baby. He

As someone who doesn’t have traditional work hours, Wag’s 24/7 drop-off and pick-up is such a relief! My 80lb puppy loves the friendly staff and his new dog friends. I really appreciate the team slowly acclimating my shy guy to the “big dog” daycare room and now he’s thriving. The facility is very clean and the staff is always kind and friendly. Love Wag!

My wife and I love Wag and most of all so does our dog, we usually have him  at Wag four days a week and Board him there When we go on any long trips.
We also have our grooming there from time to time and they do a really nice job
Love much
We are honored to have provided you with a 5-star experience at Wag Hotels - Hollywood. Thank you for your feedback, Chris!
My dog has Stayed at Wag several times from a few hours to two weeks. He is quite reserved and prefers not to mingle. However when I pick him up he is calm and appears to have had a relaxing time.

​I couldn't be happier with the care provided at Wag Hotels Hollywood! The facility is clean, well-maintained, and secure, but what truly sets them apart is the staff. They are extremely attentive, friendly, and genuinely care about every dog that comes through the door.
​Leaving a pet behind can be stressful, but their communication and professional setup give complete peace of mind. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, reliable, and high-quality place for pet boarding or daycare in the area!

I was a bit nervous boarding our kitten for 10 days. The suite was perfect for his active personality. He received 2 free cuddle sessions per day. We were able to view him anytime on the suite camera, and the staff took many photo memories for us. Even the dogs looked very happy on the playroom camera! I highly recommend Wag Hotels Hollywood for any boarding needs. Thank you to all the staff!

We have an incredible experience each time at Wag Hotel. Our two dogs have been staying there for about 4 years. Some overnights but mostly daycare. The best thing about them is the people working there. They are so generous each time we check in and out. We go there for flexibility. Sometimes we have to stay out later, and we can simply have peace of mind knowing they are safe. I absolutely recommend Wag Hotel!

My pup and I love Wag Hollywood! The pup recently had a full grooming and he looks FANTASTIC! Bandit isn't exactly the most cooperative pup for grooming sessions, to the point other places previously gave him a horrendous cut and razor burn. However, Wag's grooming team gave him an amazing cut! They were amazing and collaborative to work with, she called to confirm what I wanted and gave suggestions for his summer cut. He is now summer ready, so other pups better watch out!

Had to board a foster in my care last minute.  WAG was clean, friendly, professional!  Got a photo multiple times a day of him having a great time and a phone call when he wasn't eating as he should.  Really appreciate the care!
